title: 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design
version_effective_date: 2010 ADA Standards, current DOJ online edition as accessed 2026-08-31
jurisdiction_scope: U.S. ADA Titles II/III where the 2010 Standards apply
role_scope: covered facility/accessibility design and operation context
notes: The Standards expressly address temporary and permanent buildings/facilities and accessible routes. Applicability to a specific event/installation requires legal/site analysis; one product label does not establish route compliance.

title: ADA Accessibility Standards — Chapter 4: Accessible Routes

notes: Use for route/accessibility scope and technical-criteria existence, not as a substitute for event/venue accessibility approval.

source_owner: U.S. National Park Service — National Capital Region
title: National Capital Area Fire and Life Safety Requirements for Outdoor Events and Tent Use
jurisdiction_scope: National Park Service National Capital Region permitted outdoor-event context only
role_scope: permit holders, event staff, crowd-management and AHJ interfaces
freshness_trigger: NPS NCR/AHJ permit or fire-life-safety requirement revision
notes: Strong example that event layout, egress, emergency planning, crowd management and occupancy approval can belong to event/AHJ processes. Must not be generalized nationally.
